subject: ⏰ Reminder — $event_name is $when_phrase
body:
Hi $recipient_name,

Quick reminder: you RSVP'd to the event below, and it is $when_phrase. Practical details are repeated here so they're easy to find on your phone.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
EVENT DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Event:           $event_name
Date:            $event_date
Time:            $start_time – $end_time
Location:        $location
Host:            $host_name
Your RSVP:       $rsvp_status_display ($num_guests guest(s))
Event ID:        $event_id

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

LAST-MINUTE CHECKS

  • Bring photo ID if entry requires it.
  • Plan your travel — public transport on the day: $travel_note.
  • Bring something to write on / a charged device if you'd like to take notes.
  • Programme: $programme_summary

CAN'T MAKE IT ANY MORE?

Please update your RSVP to 'Not Going' on the Events portal — your place can then go to someone on the waitlist. No-shows hold back future invites for everyone.

Looking forward to seeing you.

Kind regards,
University Events Team
